displayName: Network interfaces should be connected to an approved subnet of the approved virtual network
description: This policy blocks network interfaces from connecting to a virtual network or subnet that is not approved. https://aka.ms/VirtualEnclaves

metadata.description: The effect determines what happens when the policy rule is evaluated to match
Resource Id of the approved virtual network. Example: /subscriptions/YourSubscriptionId/resourceGroups/YourResourceGroupName/providers/Microsoft.Network/virtualNetworks/Name
List of string subnet names that the virtual machine can connect to. By default, all subnets are approved.
Set this value to true to allow NICs to connect to all subnets within the virtual network.
